## Fixed

- **Deleting a Drime backup still took a long time.** Before deleting, r2backup
  counted every file in the backup, which on Drime is one request per folder:
  tens of minutes for a big code folder. It now skips the count and deletes the
  folder straight away. A backup of 118,000 files was deleted in under a minute.

- **Deleted backups could stay in the Drime trash.** Deleting from the command
  line now waits for the backup to be emptied from the Drime trash before
  exiting.
